title: Run an electrical conduit between two points on a level
task: Create an electrical Conduit between two XYZ points on a level with Conduit.Create -- the arg order (conduit type first, then the two points, then the level) differs from Duct/Pipe.Create. Covers MEP conduit modelling.

pitfalls.symptom: The conduit is created but mis-placed, or the call reads wrong, because arguments were passed in the Duct/Pipe order.
pitfalls.cause: Conduit.Create's signature is (Document, ElementId conduitType, XYZ start, XYZ end, ElementId level) -- the TYPE is first and the LEVEL is last, unlike Duct.Create/Pipe.Create which take systemType, type, level, then the two points.
pitfalls.fix: Pass conduitType.Id, start, end, level.Id in exactly that order.

pitfalls.symptom: First() throws InvalidOperationException 'Sequence contains no elements' collecting ConduitType.
pitfalls.cause: The document's template has no electrical/conduit content, so no ConduitType is loaded.
pitfalls.fix: Confirm the ConduitType collector is non-empty before First(); use an electrical/systems template or load conduit families first.
